figures.caption: Fig. 1 (a) Growth rate, (b) resistivity, and (c) S/Co atomic ratio versus CoCl2(TMEDA) pulse length at di /uniFB00 erent deposition temperatures. Schematic structure of the CoCl2(TMEDA) precursor is shown as an inset in (a). Growth rate, resistivity and S/Co atomic ratio versus (d) H2S pulse length (at 275 °C) and (e) deposition temperature. Thicknesses and S/Co ratios were determined by EDS. The error bars in growth rates and S/Co ratios represent statistical measurement uncertainty (one standard deviation). The shaded areas around resistivity values represent /uniFB01 lm uniformity, i.e. variation (one standard deviation) in sheet resistance over the 5 × 5 cm 2 silicon substrate (resistivities calculated using a single thickness value per sample). The dashed lines are meant to guide the eye. The /uniFB01 lms were deposited on silicon (native oxide) using, unless otherwise noted, 1000 cycles with 1.0 s CoCl2(TMEDA) and 2.0 s H2S pulses separated by 1.0 s N2 purges.

Fig. 2 (a) Grazing incidence X-ray di /uniFB00 ractograms (all Miller indices refer to Co9S8) and (b) SEM images of /uniFB01 lms deposited at di /uniFB00 erent temperatures. The /uniFB01 lms were deposited on silicon (native oxide) using 1000 cycles except for the thicker /uniFB01 lm deposited at 180 °C using 3000 cycles that is shown in the inset. Film thicknesses determined by EDS are indicated in (b).

Fig. 3 (a) Thickness, (b) SEM images (thickness and resistivity values also indicated; thicknesses in italic measured by EDS, others by XRR; dl. = detection limit), (c) resistivity, and (d) root-mean-square roughness ( R q) of /uniFB01 lms deposited at 275 °C on di /uniFB00 erent substrates versus number of ALD cycles. The dashed lines are meant to guide the eye. The error bars of EDS thicknesses represent statistical measurement uncertainty (one standard deviation). For XRR, the uncertainty was estimated to be smaller than the symbol size. The error bars in roughness represent variation within 3 -5 AFM images recorded per sample (one standard deviation).
Fig. 4 SEM images of /uniFB01 lms deposited on di /uniFB00 erent substrates at 275 °C using 1000 cycles.

Fig. 6 Summary of crystalline phases observed during in situ hightemperature GIXRD measurements performed under di /uniFB00 erent atmospheres. The widths of the lines referring to the di /uniFB00 erent phases represent an estimation on the relative amounts of the di /uniFB00 erent phases based on peak intensities.
